Name: Stardew Valley Discord Rich Presence
Author: justrecht
Description:
[size=6][color=#4FC3F7][b]Simple Discord Rich Presence for Stardew Valley[/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][i]Bring your Stardew Valley adventure to life on Discord with a clean, lightweight, and distraction-free integration.[/i][/size]

[line]

[size=5]✨ [b]What This Mod Does[/b][/size]

This mod automatically displays your in-game activity so your friends can see what you’re doing at a glance—no messages required.

[list]
[*][b]Real-Time Updates:[/b] Your Discord status updates instantly to reflect your current progress.[/*]
[*][b]Farmer Details:[/b] Displays your farmer’s name, farm name, and current gold count.[/*]
[*][b]Location Tracking:[/b] Automatically updates as you move (e.g., "Relaxing at the Farm," "Visiting Pierre's").[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Support:[/b] Indicates if you are hosting a co-op session and displays the current player count.[/*]
[*][b]Menu Detection:[/b] Shows when you are creating a character or loading a save.[/*]
[/list]

[line]

[size=5]⚙️ [b]Overview[/b][/size]

[b]Plug and Play[/b]
This mod works automatically in the background with [b]no configuration required[/b].

[b]Lightweight[/b]
Designed to be subtle and informative. Perfect for players who want to share their progress without clutter or unnecessary features.
